location: Western Forests — Old-growth elven forests west of the fort.
rewardEnvelope: the fee is as agreed, and the company keeps what it hauls back
stakeIfLost: If the company fails, the Pass loses the captive and merchants will avoid the road, shutting off its trade.
arrival: came back a second time · was in a hurry and did not hide it
OPPOSES: poacher · keep her captive long enough to sell them to buyers on the next trade night

cast.name: Trihild of the Pass
cast.who: the tollwarden who keeps the narrow road through the passes and bargains for safe passage.
cast.want: to recover a captive taken from the road and have them returned to the Pass

bible.goal: to bring a captive taken from the Western Forests back to the Pass as Trihild ordered

arcStep: Search the Western Forests where Trihild's scouts last saw anyone taken, using the warden's bearings
